correctness.rationale: On the first Brillouin zone set \(t_j=(\ell p_j)^2\in[0,\pi^2]\). For \(g(t)=\cos\sqrt t\), \(g''(t)=(\sin r-r\cos r)/(4r^3)>0\) for \(0<r<\pi\), with positive endpoint limit, so \(g\) is strictly convex. Jensen therefore gives the average cosine at least the cosine of the root-mean-square angle; monotonicity of cosine on \([0,\pi]\) yields \(E_\ell(p)\le|p|_2^2\), with equality exactly when all \(p_j^2\) coincide. Matching the cosine Taylor series gives the correction \(-\nu\ell^2\operatorname{Var}(p_j^2)/12\). The finite checker is only corroborative and is not used as proof of the global statement.
risks: The theorem is only for the free equilateral standard-Kirchhoff principal band; higher bands, potentials, magnetic phases, and unequal lengths are excluded.
